import re
from text import slugify
cases = {"Hello, World!": "hello-world", "Hello World": "hello-world", "What?! Really...": "what-really",
         "C++ is great!": "c-is-great", "Top 10 Tips!": "top-10-tips", "  Foo   Bar  ": "foo-bar",
         "(Hello) [World]": "hello-world", "simple": "simple", "Price: $100": "price-100"}
for s, exp in cases.items():
    r = slugify(s)
    assert r == exp, (s, r, exp)
for s in ["a@b#c d", "x & y", "Hi!!! there???", "#tag 'quoted' \"dq\""]:
    r = slugify(s)
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*", r), (s, r)
print("ok")

note: slugify strips punctuation/symbols on several new inputs, output is clean a-z0-9-hyphen slug
